QUOTE: ret & 0xFF80 ≠ 0 ? ──yes──► mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) ... append " : " (only if high part already written) ▼ mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret); "The two strings are joined with `" : "`. Either part can be absent."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the high-level module part and low-level part of the code layout, and says `mbedtls_strerror` renders both, joined with " : ", when both are present.
